stages.search_scope: Repository historical topology grammars plus representative public device classes and designs across tokamak, spherical tokamak, stellarator, field-reversed configuration, mirror, laser inertial confinement, pulsed-power Z-pinch, and representative FRC/stellarator patents. The mapping is a plasma/control-region abstraction and is not an exhaustive prior-art search, patentability opinion, or freedom-to-operate analysis.
